Rejected because the crossing had to be removed by changing the layout, not by accepting the bridge.

--check: crossings 0 bridges / 0 touching bends, routes 7/7 near-minimal 0 detours, origins 7/7, but 'labels: 7/7 placed, 0 on route cells, 0 skipped, 2 ambiguous owners' plus the ambiguity warning. Ambiguity was measured at the two tight label centres: (28,21) for '25 GbE' (own route core->cache is 6 cells away, core->web's adjacent stem 4) and (32,32) for 'session' (own route 5 cells away, web->db's row-30 run 2).

Accepted layout: chain column in the second slot with cache to its left and db far right. Moves the graph's own bounding box to the left of the cache descents, which is what gives '25 GbE' and 'session' interior slots: --check reads 0 bridges, 0 detours, 7/7 origins, 0 ambiguous owners, and the harness capture confirms --check on the same spec (evidence/v1/check.txt).
